mapper.select: SELECT A.PARA_CODE paraCode, A.PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE paraDisplayType, A.CONTENT content, A.PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity, A.REDIS_FIELD redisField, B.PARA_NAME paraName, B.IS_FORBID isForbid, B.IS_UP_REDIS isUpRedis, B.FORBID_ENUM forbidEnum, B.PARAM_DATA_TYPE paramDataType, B.PARAM_MATH_TYPE paramMathType, B.PARAM_VALUE_NONE paramValueNone, A.IS_FRESH_CAN_TRD isFreshCanTrd FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL A INNER JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA B ON A.PARA_CODE = B.PARA_CODE WHERE B.PARA_CODE = #{paraCode}
SELECT COUNT(PARA_CODE) FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA WHERE PARA_CODE = #{paraCode}
SELECT COUNT(IND_ID) FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR WHERE EXPR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{paraCode}),'%')
SELECT IND_ID indId, EXPR, ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_SEC_TYPE assetSecType FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR WHERE EXPR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{paraCode}),'%')

SELECT A.PARA_CODE paraCode, A.PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE paraDisplayType, A.REDIS_FIELD redisField, B.PARA_NAME paraName, A.CONTENT content FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL A INNER JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA B ON A.PARA_CODE = B.PARA_CODE WHERE B.PARA_CODE = #{paraCode}
select PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity, CONTENT content from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL where PARA_CODE = #{paraCode}
select DISTINCT MODEL_VALUE from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA where MODEL_CODE = #{modelCode}
